query:
SELECT 
  'molecules' as entity, COUNT(*) as total, 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM plant_molecules) as linked,
  ROUND((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM plant_molecules) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as coverage_pct
FROM molecules
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'plants', COUNT(*),
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT plant_id) FROM plant_molecules),
  ROUND((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT plant_id) FROM plant_molecules) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1)
FROM plants
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'plant_terroirs', 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants),
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT plant_id) FROM plant_terroirs),
  ROUND((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT plant_id) FROM plant_terroirs) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants), 1)
